objective.text: Select language from an application allowlist instead of accepting arbitrary locale identifiers.

difficulty.rationale: Select only locales the product deliberately supports rather than treating input syntax as product support.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The product supports en and fr only. Invalid or unsupported locale input should use en.

stem: Which locale-selection policy meets that requirement?

options.text: Use the requested value only if it is exactly en or fr; otherwise select en.
options.rationale: An explicit supported-locale list implements the product policy and a defined fallback.

options.text: Use the browser’s first language value even if the application has no matching locale.
options.rationale: That ignores the stated supported set and fallback requirement.
options.misconception: That ignores the stated supported set and fallback requirement.

options.text: Call setLocale with any submitted string and expect it to validate the supported list.
options.rationale: setLocale does not automatically know this product’s two-locale policy.
options.misconception: setLocale does not automatically know this product’s two-locale policy.

options.text: Accept any two-letter value because every such code has installed translations.
options.rationale: A syntactically plausible locale does not prove the application ships or supports its translations.
options.misconception: A syntactically plausible locale does not prove the application ships or supports its translations.
